name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
 attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87216832378
  Webinar ID: 872 1683 2378
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,87216832378# OR +16699009128,,87216832378#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of February 28, 2024 City Council Closed Session and February 28, 2024 City
Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1. Volunteer Appreciation – Recognition of 2023 City Volunteers

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda and within the Council’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three
minutes. Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE – DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON THE
  USE OF THE ZOOM PLATFORM FOR CITY COUNCIL AND COUNCIL
  COMMITTEE MEETINGS - City Council to provide direction on the practice of
  utilizing the Zoom platform for Council Committee and City Council Meetings.

2.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE – CIVIC CENTER EXTERIOR CAMERAS AND
  COMMUNITY EMERGENCY RESPONSE TEAM PROGRAM - City Council to
  receive and file this report.

3.  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE REPORT: APPROVAL OF PROFESSIONAL
  SERVICE AGREEMENT FOR LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES ON
  THE CIVIC CENTER COURTYARD IMPROVEMENTS AND ART
  INSTALLATION HONORING VETERANS - Award a professional services
  agreement to Kiesel Design Landscape Architecture for the Civic Center Courtyard
  Improvements and Art Installation Honoring Veterans Project in the amount of
  $71,000, authorize the City Manager to approve any amendments within the $29,000
  contingency and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the agreement on behalf of
  the City.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS: None

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective March 1, 2024 in the amount of
  $642,434.07

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. CONCESSION STAND OPERATION AGREEMENTS WITH WESTLAKE
  AGOURA GIRLS SOFTBALL LEAGUE AND THE AMERICAN YOUTH
  SOCCER ORGANIZATION - Approve the Concession Stand Operation
  Agreement with the Westlake Agoura Girls Softball League and the American
  Youth Soccer Organization for three years and have the Mayor execute the
  agreements.

  2. RIGHT OF ENTRY AGREEMENT WITH WESTLAKE VILLAGE GOLF
  COURSE FOR THE 2024 FIREWORKS EVENT - Approve the Right of Entry
  Agreement with the Westlake Village Golf Course for the 2024 July 4th fireworks
  event and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the agreement on behalf of
  the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  STATUS UPDATE ON THE CALIFORNIA EMPLOYERS’ PENSION
  PREFUNDING TRUST AND OTHER POST EMPLOYMENT BENEFIT TRUST
  WITH THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEE RETIREMENT SYSTEM - City
  Council to receive and file this report.

2.  ACCEPTANCE OF A FUNDING AGREEMENT (FA9200000000M550310) WITH
  LOS ANGELES COUNTY METROPOLITAN TRANSPORTATION AUTHORITY
  FOR THE LINDERO SIDEWALK EXTENSION PROJECT (FISCAL YEAR 2023-
  2024 SIDEWALK IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AND FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025
  SIDEWALK IMPROVEMENT PROJECT) - Enter into funding agreement FA
  9200000000M550310 in the amount of $3,683,247 with Los Angeles County
  Metropolitan Transportation Authority for the Lindero Sidewalk Extension Project; and
  authorize the Mayor or City Manager to sign and execute the agreement on behalf of
  the City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF THE CUSTODY AGREEMENT WITH U.S. BANK TRUST
  COMPANY AND VARIOUS FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND ADVISORY
  AGREEMENTS WITH STIFEL, NICOLAUS & COMPANY, INC. - Approve the
  Custody Agreement with U.S. Bank Trust Company, approve the financial
  management and advisory agreements with Stifel, Nicolaus & Company, Inc.,
  authorize the Mayor to execute the agreements, and find that the agreements are
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.
 ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, March 7, 2024 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  March 7, 2024
